name: Kagi
summary: Paid, ad-free search engine with privacy protections and the Kagi Assistant for AI chat.
description: Kagi is a subscription search engine without ads or tracking. The Kagi Assistant gives access to several AI models, alongside a browser and other tools in the Kagi ecosystem. A trial includes 100 searches. Starter costs $5 per month for 300 searches, Professional $10 per month for unlimited searches, and Ultimate $25 per month with premium AI. Prices exclude sales tax.

howToUse.title: Open Kagi and start the trial
howToUse.description: Open Kagi and choose Sign up for free. The trial includes 100 searches.

howToUse.title: Search without ads or tracking
howToUse.description: Run a query on this subscription search engine. Results come without ads or tracking. End a query with ? for a Quick Answer, or use @ and ! to limit results to one site.

howToUse.title: Ask Kagi Assistant
howToUse.description: Open Kagi Assistant for access to several AI models, with answers grounded in search results. The same ecosystem includes the Orion browser.

howToUse.title: Choose a search subscription
howToUse.description: Compare the subscriptions: Starter is $5 a month and includes 300 searches, Professional is $10 a month with unlimited searches, and Ultimate is $25 a month and adds premium AI. Sales tax sits outside these prices.
